Boy George threatens band members over pro-Israel song performance

Boy George, the lead singer of the band Culture Club, has threatened to fire band members who refuse to perform a pro-Israel song. The threat was made in response to potential objections from musicians regarding the song's political stance. The specific song and the names of the band members were not disclosed in the coverage.
